$comment: Runner pricing and free-minute allowances, dated. Prices change; this file is the ONE place they are recorded, read by ci-conventions-check's evaluator as data -- never hard-coded in code. Checked 2026-09-23 against GitHub's Actions billing documentation and Blacksmith's public pricing page. Re-verify against the source URLs below before trusting this file for a decision more than a few months past asOf.

costPerMinute.note: GitHub's published per-minute rate for a standard 2-core Linux runner beyond the plan's included minutes.

freeMinutesAllowance.note: Minutes/month, shared across the whole account (or organization on Team/Enterprise Cloud), not per repository.

storage.note: Free-plan allowances. Team and Enterprise Cloud raise these; consult the billing docs directly rather than assuming a multiple.

freeMinutesAllowance.note: Stacks ON TOP OF GitHub's own included minutes -- it is a separate allowance from a separate billing relationship, not a discount against GitHub's.
